# Endure Harm

> Datasworn `move.oracle_rollable:classic/suffer/endure_harm.endure_harm` · 1d100

- [10] The harm is mortal. Face Death.
- [10] You are dying. You need to Heal within an hour or two, or Face Death.
- [15] You are unconscious and out of action. If left alone, you come back to your senses in an hour or two. If you are vulnerable to a foe not inclined to show mercy, Face Death.
- [15] You are reeling and fighting to stay conscious. If you engage in any vigorous activity (such as running or fighting) before taking a breather for a few minutes, roll on this table again (before resolving the other move).
- [50] You are battered but still standing.
